test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/becb24aca804e81b54a619cb943ee21f6070177ac5002fdb3eef3a2ed0ee5841.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) One element in each box is flipped horizontally row wise.

2) No change the rest of the elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f4308258ffac769086c111b5d940635ac46ae4831a68dc4edfc43c13f042d30.png] 

Thus, final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e64e1fc7aba3cb1da2007de14953b37a43f0d500eaa250b5458dfd87d685d1a2.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Option 2) is incorrect because all the elements are flipped horizontally or is the mirror image.

Option 3) is incorrect because the 1st element of the 3rd row is flipped horizontally instead of the 2nd element of the 2nd row.

Option 4) is incorrect because the 2nd element of the 2nd row and 1st element of the 3rd row is flipped horizontally, which is invalid as only one element is flipped horizontally in each box.
